description: This file declares API functions and includes necessary headers for device prioritization utilities in the RDK component. It defines functions for retrieving parameter names and publishing events related to device priority management.

methods.name: getParamName
methods.description: Returns the parameter name as a string based on the specified path.

methods.name: getDevicePrioParamName
methods.description: Returns the device priority parameter name as a string given a devicePrioParam_t value.

methods.name: DevicePrio_PublishToEvent
methods.description: Publishes an event with the specified name and data, indicating updates in device priority status.
